desc: Light porcelain bathroom floor with selected grout joints carefully cleared for repair, beside a grout saw, float, and a small neat dustpan of dry grout debris.
reuse_notes: Use for bathroom-floor regrouting, tile-joint maintenance, shower-threshold finish work, small bathroom renovation, and similar preparation articles. It depicts a generic repair-preparation scene, never a JK Prestige project or a guarantee that surface regrouting resolves underlying moisture problems.
